# suzu_web_script.txt — the web gate's script (Phase 8 step 59b, DECISIONS_7 #29): rendered by the lab's
# engine in node (tools/suzu_web_gate.mjs) and by the native reference (tests/suzu_web_reference.c), compared
# record by record. One section per Suzu voice kind: two notes on two MPE channels under breath, a bend on the
# first, the second released, the trace and the inspection snapped three times. Grammar: rate R | create |
# param NAME VALUE | apply | trace MASK | decim D (59c: the ring's density) | midi BLOCK STATUS D1 D2 (before that 128-frame block) | snap BLOCK
# (after it) | render N (the run's blocks; its midi and snaps are consumed). Numbers decimal or 0x hex.
rate 48000

# kind 0
create
param voice_kind 0
apply
trace 1
decim 2
midi 0 0xB0 101 0
midi 0 0xB0 100 6
midi 0 0xB0 6 15
midi 0 0xB1 2 80
midi 0 0xB2 2 80
midi 0 0x91 57 100
midi 0 0x92 64 90
midi 150 0xE1 0 72
midi 200 0xD1 60 0
midi 260 0x82 64 0
snap 125
snap 250
snap 374
render 375

# kind 2 under the stick-slip bow (step 80). The modal string under the bow is NOT in the gate: the stick/slip branch is a
# discontinuity, and the lattice's per-sample sinf (the libm difference the kind's tolerance covers) flips a branch at one
# sub-step, which moves the snapshot's decimated trace points past any tolerance while the audio stays within −80 dB; the
# chains' paths call no libm and carry the bow bit for bit (DECISIONS_12 #4).
create
param voice_kind 2
param bow_mode 1
param bow_position 0.12
apply
trace 4
decim 2
midi 0 0xB0 101 0
midi 0 0xB0 100 6
midi 0 0xB0 6 15
midi 0 0xB1 2 80
midi 0 0xB2 2 80
midi 0 0x91 57 100
midi 0 0x92 64 90
midi 150 0xE1 0 72
midi 200 0xD1 60 0
midi 260 0x82 64 0
snap 125
snap 250
snap 374
render 375
